svg.title: HYDRA-UMC-SDK architecture
svg.desc: HYDRA-UMC-SDK holds the schemas and the OpenAPI slice, the clients that validate against them, the bridge helpers built on the contract, and the tools that check the schemas against the validator and copy the shared tooling into every repository.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: One set of contracts, four clients that enforce them, and the tools that keep every repository the same.
